data.narrative:
Arxlight is a seed-stage Defense & Security company founded by Sagar Patel and Paul White. Valuation analysis draws from a comparable universe of 4 same-sector, same/adjacent-stage peers spanning seed and Series A funding rounds, supplemented by reference to a broader Defense & Security comp set including 2 public companies (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms such as UFORCE, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, and Saronic.

The peer-median approach anchors the analysis. Four direct comparables—Stark Defence ($4.0B, Series A), UFORCE ($1.0B, Seed), Singularity ($400M, Series A), and NODA AI ($125M, Series A)—yield a median valuation of $700M, with a range spanning $125M to $4.0B. This method is applicable given stage and sector alignment, though the wide dispersion reflects heterogeneity in capital intensity and investor appetite within defense tech.

The triangulated analysis, supported by a single method, implies a valuation range of $595M to $805M, with a median of $700M. This range is material and warrants scrutiny around key uncertainties: the degree to which Arxlight's technology differentiation and team pedigree align with higher-quartile comparables like UFORCE versus lower-quartile peers like NODA AI, and the extent to which seed-stage investors in this sector are currently pricing for near-term revenue traction or longer-dated exit scenarios. Additional methodologies would strengthen conviction.
